entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for it and it's not working at all.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the features?

It's definitely a technical fault. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I try. I think the one I received is just broken. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work properly.
I completely understand your frustration. A new device should work perfectly right out of the box. So you believe the unit is defective, correct?
Yes, I'm sure it's defective. I'm just so let down. I was really looking forward to using it.
I see. I'm so sorry for the trouble this has caused. Let me just pull up our return policy for you... one moment, please.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've just checked, and our policy states that items can be returned for a full refund within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it only six days ago, you're well within that window.
Oh, really? So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I can process that return for you right now. I'll go ahead and email you a prepaid shipping label so you can send the defective band back to us at no charge. Once we receive it, we'll issue your full refund.
Wow, that's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I was going to be stuck with it. You've really helped me out today.
You are very welcome. We want to make sure our customers are happy. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and we appreciate you being a VeloFit customer.
